summary: The goal here is to introduce the Ising model without going into details about its solution. Suppose we have a system of N sites with two possible states. That could, for instance, represent localized spins 1/2, that can be either up or down. Importantly, any two neighboring sites are coupled via an interaction -J. In this way a positive value for J favors the parallel alignment of neighboring states. Additionally we could think of a term to manipulate the state at each site individually.
